Review of the pending ownership proposal `e7b55be765892bd70cdd155d8ef72e7578bae8756ab5373008eb55c63b521f0d` found two items to resolve before treating the UNKNOWN fence repair as complete:

1. `_published_delivery` currently accepts a published Developer result/native Pending Review ACK and AutomationRun success without binding the preserved provider account/Dot identity, governance scope/admission, original native-start record, local raw result, or selected-format/source-capture audit. The positive fixture `PublishedOwnership.test_settled_original_releases_guard_without_changing_provider_or_ledgers` (`0954bd97…`) succeeds with those records absent. Preserve the original provider row; any historical settlement needs a narrowly verified proof of the same original operation and its actual completed effects. A native ACK or corrected reply must not be represented as an original provider receipt.
2. `abitdot_primary.claim` separately rejects an old dispatching/unknown record for a different run of the same owner/automation. The proposal changes only the cross-stack Task ownership helper. QA uses its own automation, but future runs of the original Developer automation still need this independent fence handled safely and tested.

The exact original relay status/receipt route is being inspected first. No provider/model/Git replay, ledger reset, gate change or competing product edit has been performed by this review. The concurrent proposal is preserved for review. Current observed QA successor remains blocked before submission; independent QA/closing PM acceptance remains open.

Reviewed proposal: `/srv/abit-dev-linux/abit-ai/deployment/agentic-governance-full-20261113/governed-published-delivery-ownership-v1-proposal-20261115/agentic_ownership.py`. This is a source review finding, not an activation or failure claim about a new live repair.

Scoped Core repair is live in [draft platform PR #5](https://github.com/ABiT-Consulting/abit-ai-platform/pull/5), stacked on [PR #4](https://github.com/ABiT-Consulting/abit-ai-platform/pull/4). Only the selected control router `c1597567` and published-delivery ownership guard `e7b55be7` were installed; Root performed one Main stop/start while preserving QA, provider/raw history and existing Native human control sequence 14. That exact existing Retry was mirrored without a new Native intent.

Local evidence: eight actual control-model/route + temporary-ledger cases, ownership regressions, API verification, and isolated integration (91 passed, 0 failed). Root deployment receipt SHA `ea10514dea5cc121bc0571aff5f2af2bd3a8a8ad7c74cc06fb4cd8624f72fbc7`; actual 71-file cohort SHA `794cd680754c3e1c2e83dc49eb93d644d7095b5cbf9463c48cbe04f900bbad0c`. Selected source commits `9921aa0c` and `c0faac12` are preserved in review head `76f2f049`; the full canonical router is not the selected runtime overlay.

The original Developer result is published/handed off. Independent QA reached context read and delivery verification; its latest verification call returned 409 and is uncertain, with the exact cause being checked read-only. No retry or repair action is implied. Closing PM, native duplicate-callback proof and genuine first-flow closure are still pending. Keep this issue open.
